newsitem.title: FRANCE: No impact from UK tax - Gle des Eaux.
newsitem.headline: No impact from UK tax - Gle des Eaux.

text.p: A special windfall tax levied by the British government on utilities companies will not affect the four British water companies owned by French group Cie Generale des Eaux, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
The four water supply companies do not fall into the category of privatised utilities being levied, he said.

General Utilities Plc, the British holding company of the French group, controls Three Valleys Water, North Surrey, Hundred Tendring and Folkestone & District, which were already privately owned. They generate two billion francs in annual revenues, he said.
The British government announced on Wednesday details of a plan to raise 5.2 billion stg by taxing privatised utility companies, to fund job creation measures and capital investment on schools.
